name: LLM or Duck?
description: Are you more like an AI language model or a duck? Cast your vote and see how the class compares!

intro.message:
Welcome to LLM or Duck!

In a moment, you'll be asked a very important question: Are you more like a large language model (like ChatGPT or Claude) or more like a duck?

Think carefully about your answer!

choices: I'm more like an LLM (Large Language Model)

discussion.message:
Take a moment to discuss:

• Why did you choose LLM or Duck?
• What qualities do LLMs and ducks have?
• Are they really that different?

Teacher: Lead the class discussion, then click Next when ready to end the game.

end.message: Thanks for playing LLM or Duck! Whether you're more like an AI or a waterfowl, you're all wonderful humans. 🦆🤖
